main_text.p: hi,sic etiam Scævola facies gratum. 4. à comparatione parium: ut de aliis rebus, quæ ad disputandum proponuntur, disputare consuevit Lælius: sic quoq; de amicitia disputabit. In hoc vero postremo argumento latet distributio dialogi trimembris: Lælius enim de amicitia dicet, quid sentiat, qualem existimet, & præcepta dabit. Mihi vero erit Scævola confirmat orationem. Fannÿ: eiusq; argumentum à fine petitum per comparationem parium & distributionem subiecti repetit. Ego vero non gravarer. Lælius modestè tergiversatur, & certis de causis disputationem de amicitia se subterfugere simulat: hocq; modo concludit.

p.i: Si mihi confiderem non gravarer de amicitia disputare:

main_text.p: Ego vero non. Propositionis sententia: cujus consequens probatur adjuncto disputationis hujus, & causa adjuvante. quia disputare de amicitia est res præclara: & otium suppetit. Sed quis ego. Assumptio: quæ seipsum extenuat remotione causarum, facultatis nimirum & doctrinæ: quæ ad dispu-tandas

page.notes: Two syllogistic marks (a bracket-like sign before "At" and before "Assumptio") are printed in the margin of the lines and are not transcribed. The word "Lælius" and "Scævola" are printed with æ ligatures; "Fannÿ" has a superscript y-like mark, read as ÿ. The line-end split "dispu-/tandas" is the last printed line and is kept as one word with its printed hyphen. Some words such as "existimet" and "præclara" were read with some doubt in the ligatures and could be checked against the scan.
